class.name: SteamOwnership
class.brief_description: Detached base app and DLC ownership from a verified encrypted app ticket.
class.description: The trusted publisher issues this receipt after decryption, ownership checks, and atomic consumption of the exact outstanding backend challenge. Verification accepts tickets up to five minutes old with up to 30 seconds of forward clock skew. The challenge store also enforces the backend's challenge expiry. The receipt represents the ticket's entitlement snapshot.

method.name: get_checked_dlc_ids
method.description: Returns the exact DLC AppIDs checked during verification.

method.name: get_identity
method.description: Returns the publisher-scoped Steam identity verified by the encrypted ticket and backend challenge.

method.name: get_issued_at_unix
method.description: Returns the verified ticket issue time in Unix seconds.

method.name: get_owned_dlc_ids
method.description: Returns the requested DLC AppIDs whose ownership the ticket proves.

method.name: owns_app
method.description: Returns whether this receipt proves ownership of its base app.

method.name: owns_dlc
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the ticket confirms ownership of the requested DLC AppID.
